summary: Ran mandatory local-worker regression on http://127.0.0.1:8787. Both required backend suites passed fully (7/7). Frontend compare flow still fails: product selection works and 4th is blocked, but Compare submit repeatedly does not render side-by-side results under E2E automation.

ui_bugs.issue: After selecting products, clicking Compare did not show compare results in 3 separate Playwright runs (timeouts waiting for [data-testid="compare-results"]).

integration_issues.issue: Selection cap behavior passed, but compare results rendering remained non-deterministic/failed under automated flow; blocked completion of downstream compare UI validations.

action_items: Fix CompareWorkspace submit/render path so [data-testid="compare-results"] reliably appears after selecting >=2 products.
Investigate state sync between selection updates and compare submit action; re-check stale-state usage during rapid toggles.
After compare fix, rerun full browser flow for finder/search/filter, product detail/gallery, and contact/RFQ carry-over in one pass.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO route-policy fixes appear effective: 352 baseline route contracts pass, with 333 canonical + 18 redirects + one 410 and sitemap exactness passing in both required suites.
In compare-workspace.tsx, compare() still posts `selected` state (not ref). During rapid toggle interactions, this can be stale vs immediate mutable ref updates and may explain flaky submit behavior.
No severe hydration/runtime console exceptions were captured; observed console output was mainly aborted navigation/analytics requests and preload warning.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (compare preconditions pass, compare results render blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local OpenNext worker needed Node 22; starting with `npx -y node@22 /app/nextjs/node_modules/.bin/opennextjs-cloudflare preview` restored 127.0.0.1:8787. Required backend suites were rerun after worker restore and passed. UI blocker remains compare submit/results rendering under automation after 3 attempts; stop condition was applied per loop-prevention guidance.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /compare -> search LED -> select 3 products -> 4th shows max notice and is blocked -> click Compare. Expected: compare table appears with toggle/print. Actual: timeout waiting for [data-testid="compare-results"]. This repeated across 3 runs. Likely root cause: selection/submit state synchronization defect in CompareWorkspace under rapid selection transitions (code uses selectedRef for toggle immediacy but compare() still reads state variable `selected`).
